name: Fibery
description: Your Fibery tasks and projects on the calendar, from any database with a date field. Move one here (drag it, or Move) and its date changes in Fibery; change it in Fibery and the calendar follows within a minute.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: In Fibery: your avatar, Settings, API Keys, then Generate.

settings.label: Tasks
settings.help: The database whose items are tasks
settings.pendingText: Your databases appear here once the workspace and API key are saved (within a minute).

settings.label: Task date
settings.help: The date field that puts a task on the calendar
settings.pendingText: Choose the task database and save; its date fields appear here.

options.label: Always all-day, on the due date
At their time, unless it's midnight

settings.label: Task details to show
settings.pendingText: Choose the task database and save; its fields appear here.

settings.label: Hide tasks marked
settings.help: Optional: a checkbox field that keeps a task off the calendar
settings.pendingText: Choose the task database and save; its checkbox fields appear here.

settings.label: Overdue tasks on today
settings.help: Unfinished tasks whose date has passed show on today, marked overdue

settings.label: Projects
settings.help: Optional: a database whose items are projects
settings.pendingText: Your databases appear here once the workspace and API key are saved (within a minute).

settings.label: Project dates
settings.help: Usually a date range, shown as a bar across its days
settings.pendingText: Choose the project database and save; its date fields appear here.

settings.label: Project details to show
settings.pendingText: Choose the project database and save; its fields appear here.

settings.label: Hide projects marked
settings.pendingText: Choose the project database and save; its checkbox fields appear here.

settings.label: Longest project to show
settings.help: In days. Longer ones, like ongoing areas of work, stay off the calendar. 0 shows all.

settings.label: Hide finished items
settings.help: Items in a final workflow state, such as Done or Cancelled

settings.label: Include descriptions
settings.help: Each item's description, in plain text, below its details
